settings.title: Pain Management Group
settings.description: Hospital-based pain management. PMG partners with hospitals to build and run sustainable pain programs.

home.heroDescription: The experts in hospital-based pain management. We build and run high-performing pain programs with you, turning pain services into a quality win and a sustainable service line.
home.statsTitle: Two decades of hospital-based pain programs, measured, not estimated.
home.statsDescription: We manage every partner program through data, with high visibility into performance. These are the numbers we lead with, and the ones rural communities feel most.

differentiators.title: Outcomes-driven
differentiators.body: We manage every program through data: quality outcomes, program performance, and financials, fully visible to our partners.

differentiators.title: Physician-led
differentiators.body: Every program is led by a board-certified, fellowship-trained pain physician, supported by rigorously trained APPs.

differentiators.title: Truly aligned incentives
differentiators.body: In our joint-venture model, what's good for the patient is good for the hospital, the providers, and the community.

steps.title: We listen first.
steps.body: A conversation about your community's needs, your existing services, and whether a pain program makes sense.

steps.title: We build the program.
steps.body: Physician recruiting, care team training, workflows, and compliance, stood up inside your hospital, under your roof.

steps.title: You keep control.
steps.body: Your brand, your governance, your community, with full transparency into operations and results.

steps.title: The program matures.
steps.body: Quality outcomes, volumes, and financial performance tracked in the open, so the program earns its place, year after year.

home.storyTitle: Take pain services from missing to indispensable.
home.storyDescription: Hear how partner hospitals turned pain management into one of their strongest service lines, clinically and financially.

faqs.question: Why not just recruit a pain physician and do this ourselves?
faqs.answer: Recruiting one physician isn't a program. We bring the clinical model, the operational playbook, and the bench strength to make a service line last, especially in small communities.

faqs.question: We don't want to share revenue. Is the JV really worth it?
faqs.answer: In our joint-venture model, PMG only succeeds when the program succeeds. We'll walk through the economics, the path to profitability, and how startup investment is shared, in plain numbers.

faqs.question: Are we giving up operating control?
faqs.answer: No. Programs run inside your hospital, under your brand, with governance you help define, and full transparency into operations, compliance, and results.

faqs.question: Will the program actually last in a community our size?
faqs.answer: 20 years, 40 partnerships, 95% retention. Longevity is the metric we're proudest of, and the one rural communities need most. Board-certified, fellowship-trained physicians and a rigorous APP onboarding process are how we make it stick.

home.locationsTitle: 40 hospitals and health systems, 68 care locations. Mostly rural. All hospital-based.
home.locationsDescription: Pain expertise shouldn't require a two-hour drive. We bring it to the hospitals communities already trust.
